summary: Channel vocoder. The main input is the modulator (a voice, drums, anything); its spectral shape, measured in 8 to 40 log-spaced bands, is imposed on a carrier: the machine's own 8-voice synth (saw and pulse with a noise blend, detune, glide and an envelope) played by notes and chords, white noise, or any machine wired into the sidechain (input 2). Each band is a 4th-order band-pass on the modulator and on the carrier; attack and release followers, a formant shift of plus or minus 12 semitones, the modulator's highs passed through for clear consonants, a freeze of the band levels, a stereo spread of odd and even bands, Mix and Amount. Zero latency. Use it for robot and choir voices, talking pads, rhythmic textures from a drum loop and any sound made to speak.
use_for: Channel vocoder, 8 to 40 bands: a voice or drum loop speaks through its own synth played by chords, noise or a machine in the sidechain; formant shift, freeze, spread.

parameters.name: Carrier
parameters.description: What the bands are cut from: the synth (played by notes), the sidechain input (input 2), or noise
parameters.how: Chooses the carrier: the built-in synth played by notes, any machine wired into the sidechain (input 2), or white noise.
parameters.sound: Synth gives a pitched robot or choir, the sidechain makes any sound speak, noise gives a whisper.

parameters.name: Wave
parameters.description: Synth waveform: 0 % saw, 100 % pulse (square)
parameters.how: Blends the synth's oscillators from a saw (all harmonics) to a pulse (odd harmonics).
parameters.sound: A saw is bright and buzzy and clearest as speech, a pulse is hollow and reedy.

parameters.name: Noise blend
parameters.description: Synth: noise mixed into the tone, 0 to 100 %
parameters.how: Crossfades the synth's tone toward noise that follows each note's envelope.
parameters.sound: A little noise makes the consonants breathy; all of it is a whispered chord.

parameters.name: Detune
parameters.description: Synth: the two oscillators of each voice are detuned by this much (and spread left and right)
parameters.how: Detunes the two oscillators of every voice apart by this many cents and spreads them across the stereo field.
parameters.sound: More detune makes a wider, chorused carrier; zero is one steady, centred tone.

parameters.name: Glide
parameters.description: Synth: time for a new note to glide from the last one; 0 is off
parameters.how: Sets how long a note takes to slide from the previous pitch to its own.
parameters.sound: Glide makes the voice swoop between notes like a singer or a talk box.

parameters.name: Synth attack
parameters.description: Synth amplitude envelope: attack
parameters.how: Sets how long each synth note takes to rise to full level.
parameters.sound: Short attacks make a spoken, percussive voice; long ones swell in like a pad.

parameters.name: Synth decay
parameters.description: Synth amplitude envelope: decay to the sustain level
parameters.how: Sets how long the level takes to fall from the peak to the sustain level.
parameters.sound: It shapes the start of a held note; with sustain at 100 % it does nothing.

parameters.name: Synth sustain
parameters.description: Synth amplitude envelope: sustain level while the note is held
parameters.how: Sets the level a held note rests at after the decay.
parameters.sound: At 100 % a held note stays full; lower values make a note die away while it is held.

parameters.name: Synth release
parameters.description: Synth amplitude envelope: release after the note ends
parameters.how: Sets how long a note takes to fade out after its key is up.
parameters.sound: Short releases stop with the word; long ones let a chord ring on under the next syllable.

parameters.name: Bands
parameters.description: Number of filter bands, 8 to 40
parameters.how: Sets how many band-pass filters cut up the spectrum, from 8 to 40.
parameters.sound: Few bands give the classic robot with little detail; many bands keep more of the words.

parameters.name: Low
parameters.description: Centre of the lowest band, 50 to 500 Hz
parameters.how: Sets the centre frequency of the lowest band, from 50 to 500 Hz.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep more body of the voice; higher values drop the lows out.

parameters.name: High
parameters.description: Centre of the highest band, 2 to 16 kHz
parameters.how: Sets the centre frequency of the highest band, from 2 to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Higher values keep more air and clarity in the consonants; lower values are darker.

parameters.name: Width
parameters.description: Bandwidth of each band as a share of the spacing between bands (Q follows)
parameters.how: Sets how wide each band is against the gap to its neighbour: 100 % makes neighbours meet at their half-power points.
parameters.sound: Narrow bands are more articulate but thinner; wide bands are smoother and blur the words a little.

parameters.name: Attack
parameters.description: Band level follower: time to rise from 10 to 90 % of a step
parameters.how: Sets how quickly each band's level follows the modulator when it gets louder.
parameters.sound: Fast attacks keep consonants sharp; slow attacks soften and smear them.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description: Band level follower: time to fall from 90 to 10 % of a step
parameters.how: Sets how slowly each band's level lets go when the modulator gets quieter.
parameters.sound: Short releases are crisp and rhythmic, long ones run the syllables together into a wash.

parameters.name: Formant
parameters.description: Formant shift: the carrier's bands move this many semitones against the modulator's
parameters.how: Moves the carrier's bands up or down by up to 12 semitones against the modulator's bands, without changing the carrier's pitch.
parameters.sound: Down is a bigger, darker voice, up is a smaller, brighter one.

parameters.name: Sibilance
parameters.description: The modulator's highs above about 5 kHz, passed straight through, 0 to 100 %
parameters.how: Mixes in the modulator's own sound above about 5 kHz, unchanged, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: It keeps s, t and f clear, because a pitched carrier cannot make them.

parameters.name: Freeze
parameters.description: Holds the band levels where they are
parameters.how: Holds every band's level at its current value while on.
parameters.sound: The carrier keeps the vowel that was spoken when you switched it on, as a held drone.

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: Odd bands to the left, even bands to the right, 0 to 100 %
parameters.how: Moves the odd-numbered bands toward the left and the even-numbered bands toward the right, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: At 100 % the voice opens into a wide, shimmering stereo image.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the vocoder has no latency, so the dry signal is not delayed)
parameters.how: Blends the vocoded sound with the unprocessed modulator.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original voice in front and lay the carrier under it.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: 100 % = the settings as shown, 0 % = bypass (bit for bit the input), 200 % = twice the formant shift, sibilance and spread (held to their limits)
parameters.how: Scales the formant shift, the sibilance and the spread together. 0 % is bypass, 100 % your settings, 200 % doubles all three up to their limits.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to bring the plain vocoder back and then the dry voice, up to push the effect further.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Level of the vocoded sound
parameters.how: Sets the level of the vocoded sound in dB, from -24 to +24.
parameters.sound: It makes the vocoder louder or quieter without changing the sound.
